Westmoreland Resources Low Level (Scenario 1) vs. High Level (Scenario 2), with Low Participation Rate (LFPR-1) and No Other Crow Coal Development (AF-1)

After 1980, the Crow employment rate continues to rise gradually, but a higher rate of increase occurs for Scenario 2 than for 1. There is an increase of 959 from the baseline employment for Scenario 2, nearly double the 505 increase resulting from Scenario 1.
These changes in employment can be related to population growth. It should be recalled that the analysis of the Crow population increase was based on the assumptions that there would be no net migration of Crows during the study period and that the Crow population increase would tend to be constant under any set of development assumptions or projections.
